notes: Helper only: phone, Telegram code and conditional two-step password (O-012, O-018); channel posting rights required. User API, never a bot token. Checked official sources on 2026-11-09: https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-is-telegram-different-from-whatsapp documents files up to 2 GB, or 4 GB with Premium; https://telegram.org/faq_premium confirms 4 GB Premium uploads. https://core.telegram.org/api/config#upload-max-fileparts-default and https://core.telegram.org/api/files define runtime file-part limits times 524,288 bytes (documented example: 4,000 default and 8,000 Premium parts). Helper round 1 uses a conservative decimal 2,000,000,000-byte ceiling for video/audio; no Premium allowance is claimed. Photo 10 MB and text/caption 1,024 UTF-16 units are conservative Helper caps pending live verification. Up to ten photos form an album. Published requires channels.getMessages read-back. Go-live stays off. BunnieHop caps Telegram at 30 posts per day as a human-pace policy (D-052, matched to Threads), not a Telegram API quota.
